title: Inner Light · morning promo · 03-smile
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 film, 35mm look, soft natural grain, natural light only. Muted palette with periwinkle and slate-blue tones, warm haze, never clinical white. One person alone, unhurried, eyes closed or turned from the lens, never smiling at camera. Camera barely moves: a slow push-in or a held frame, no whip pans. Any phone in shot is an ordinary smartphone with a dim, unreadable screen. No text, no logos, no subtitles. Close on the same woman's face on the pillow, eyes open, a small calm smile beginning — half asleep, mostly in the eyes, not a grin and never toward the lens. Warm morning light. Slow push-in.
